purpose: Adversarial regression cases for conservative Persian context extraction; synthetic software tests only, not a clinical dataset or semantic benchmark.
policy: Tests verify conservative exclusion of explicit colloquial attribution and explicit hypothetical/translation meta-language. Negation is preserved verbatim; no sentiment or diagnosis is inferred.
